headline: Backends in Go and Rust, messaging that reaches users, and on-call for what I ship.
pitch: I write Go at DGRS Labs (Buckt, and the Loom agent engine) and wrote it earlier at Nirvana Labs; at Equity I built USSD framework components in Python and Rust for a loan service handling over 1 million loan requests a month. At DGRS Labs I also run the platform's email, queues and workers, and keep production running as sole DevOps owner.

matches.requirement: Distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages)
matches.evidence: Go: Buckt, a media library at DGRS Labs, and ChainQuery, an Ethereum indexer I wrote in Go at Nirvana Labs before moving it to Rust. Rust: reusable USSD framework components at Equity and an NFT indexer at Nirvana Labs.

matches.requirement: Help customers send timely, relevant messages at scale
matches.evidence: Run CoNexus's transactional and marketing email with Resend: password resets, one-time login codes and newsletters. Built queues and background workers for scheduled jobs off the request path.

matches.requirement: On-call for the systems you build
matches.evidence: Sole owner of DevOps at DGRS Labs: I run the servers, wrote the disaster-recovery scripts that restore the full stack, and built a dashboard that alerts to Telegram. At Equity I owned production support through rollouts across six countries.
Led a team of four delivering a USSD loan service on a platform serving 16 million customers, on Kubernetes with Redis. Optimized PostgreSQL and caching at DGRS Labs, cutting reads by 40%.

matches.requirement: Use AI to ship fast and with confidence
matches.evidence: Introduced a Claude and Codex generator–reviewer workflow with production-like Docker test environments that catches defects before deployment.

resume.summary: Lead software engineer with 5+ years building and running production backends in Go, Rust and Python. Created Buckt, a Go media library, architected a Go engine for multi-agent applications, and runs the platform's email, queues, workers and infrastructure as sole DevOps owner. Previously led delivery of a USSD loan service on a financial platform serving 16 million customers and over 1 million loan requests a month.

note:
I've been on your side of the product as a customer of email tooling: at DGRS Labs I run our password resets, one-time login codes and newsletters, and I know what a late or duplicated message costs a product.

What I'd bring first is ownership of what I ship: I build in Go, deploy it and stay on call for it, because I'm the one who runs our production.

What would be new: your posting asks for more years of distributed systems work than I have, and I've used PostgreSQL rather than MySQL, and AWS only for S3. I'd rather say that plainly and let the work speak. I'm in Lagos (UTC+1), inside your EMEA hours.
